magnitudes_source: Authored within cited ranges. Morgan et al. (1977) J. Geophys. Res. 82 pages 3719-3732 doi:10.1029/JB082i026p03719 reports 100 to 300 mW/m^2 outside the Yellowstone caldera and 600 to 700 mW/m^2 and greater inside the caldera from lakebed probes. Hurwitz and Lowenstern (2014) Rev. Geophys. 52(3) 375-411 doi:10.1002/2014RG000452 reviews the caldera total heat budget. Vaughan et al. (2012) J. Volcanol. Geotherm. Res. 233-234 pages 72-89 doi:10.1016/j.jvolgeores.2012.04.022 estimates total radiant GHF of ~2.0 GW across basin thermal areas from ASTER infrared imagery.
